Generated Narrative: ImplementationGuide ke.fhir.eclaims

KenyaEClaims

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

https://fhir.dha.go.ke/ig/eclaims/ImplementationGuide/ke.fhir.eclaims

The Kenya eClaims FHIR Implementation Guide defines standardized FHIR R4 profiles, extensions, value sets, and terminologies for electronic claims submission, preauthorization, and adjudication between healthcare providers and health insurance schemes in Kenya, including the Social Health Authority (SHA).
